name: Facet
text: Ship a live contrast checker that updates in real time as users adjust the dark theme’s colors. This guarantees visibility and clarity by letting users see the contrast ratio change instantly, which prevents unreadable text or elements. The trade-off is a small performance hit from constant recalculations, but it’s worth it for a tool where readability is non-negotiable.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A live contrast checker won’t catch the real problem—users adjust colors once, then forget to check again. The real risk is users picking low-contrast colors anyway, then abandoning the tool when text becomes unreadable. Ship a default high-contrast palette instead; it’s faster, safer, and still lets power users tweak later.
